full_judgment:
Md. Abdul Wahhab Miah J. This petition for leave to appeal has been filed against the judgment and decree dated the 13th day of February, 2012 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in First Appeal No.409 of 2010 dismissing the same. 

 5. The trial Court by its order dated 26.10.2010 rejected the plaint. The order of rejection of plaint being a decree within the meaning of section 2 (2) of the Code, the plaintiff filed First Appeal No.409 of 2010 before the High Court Division. A Division Bench by the impugned judgment and decree dismissed the appeal and maintained the order of the trial Court though for the reasons different from the trial Court; hence this petition for leave to appeal. 

 8. In view of the above, we are not required to enter into the merit of the judgment and decree passed by the High Court Division and we are of the view that complete justice would be done in the matter if the auction sale is set aside and the auction purchaser is given a lump sum amount of taka 41,00,000.00 (forty one lac) which would include the auction money of taka 16,00,000.00 (sixteen lac) deposited by him. Accordingly, this petition is disposed of in the following terms: 

 9. The auction sale held on 16.07.2009 in respect of the property described in schedule to the plaint is set aside. The plain-tiff in total shall pay a sum of taka 41,00,000.00 (forty one lac) to the auction purchaser, namely, respondent No.3, Robiul Awal, son of late Alhaj Khalilur Rahman and late Maleka Begum of 47, Hujrapur Paschim Para, Post Office-Chapai Nawabgonj, Police Station-Chapai Nawabgonj, District-Chapai Nawabgonj by a pay order on 05.09.2016, in default this leave petition shall stand dismissed and the judgment and decree shall stand revived. The petitioner is further directed to give the pay order to respondent No.3 for the said amount of taka 41,00,000.00 (forty one lac) before this Court on 05.09.2016.
